name: 13155-imageprefill-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; one engine, driven in-process through guidellm's vllm_python backend.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 8.29B params (~16.6 GB): a 28-layer language model behind a 32-layer native-resolution vision tower, spatial merge 2.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup the first 20%, no cooldown, bounded at 400 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, static seed 13155.
workload: Single-turn image+text: ONE 1280x720 JPEG (gradient, jpeg q85, one per request, distinct pixels per request) plus a 32-token question, 8 tokens out; ~1230 prompt tokens, prefix caching off.
purpose: A visual question-answering assistant reading one high-resolution photo per question, four concurrent users, single GPU.
launch:
# vLLM launch config, in the form `vllm serve --config` takes.
#
# RUNNER HAZARD: this era's AsyncEngineArgs raises TypeError on an unknown key at construction,
# so a key borrowed from a later vLLM breaks the run rather than being ignored.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
